Question Choices: Fill: Solve the system $4x + y = 11$ and $2x - y = 1$. What is $x$?
Hints: Add equations when opposite coefficients cancel the requested variable.
Solution: System: 4 × x+y=11; 2 × x-y=1. Multiply equation 1 by 1 and equation 2 by 1, then add to cancel y: (6)x=12, so x=2. Substitute back to obtain y=3. Check both equations: 4(2)+1(3)=11; 2(2)+-1(3)=1. Requested answer: 2.

Hints: Replace one variable with its equivalent expression, then solve and substitute back.
Solution: System: y=3 × x+8; 2 × x+y=3. Isolate y: y=(3)x+(8). Substitute into the other equation: (2)x+(1)[(3)x+(8)]=3. Combine: (5)x=-5, so x=-1. Then y=(3)(-1)+(8)=5. Check both equations: -3(-1)+1(5)=8; 2(-1)+1(5)=3. Requested answer: -1.
